page.notes: Greek words after "μειωτι-" and in "διάκρισις" and "καὶ" are uncertain and marked [?]. The margin note is in small italic; "infinuen-da" and "respondendo" read as printed but are not fully certain. The Greek "ἀρνησις" and "εὐχὴ" were read from the scan and may carry printer's accents differently. Printed "funt", "fese" and "fimpliciter" were corrected to sunt, sese and simpliciter (long s); the printed "fele" was taken as "sese" where the text is clear. The text ends mid-sentence at the foot of the page, as printed.
